scenes.headline: How a small model adds at any length, provably
scenes.sub: A 0.8B model, a sheet, and a three-cell window
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Zephyrine! Today: how a tiny model does long arithmetic exactly, at every length.

scenes.text: If every step reads only a three-cell view of the sheet, checking every possible view checks every run of every length.
scenes.say: Each step sees only three cells. So a finite check covers every run.

steps.say: The sheet holds everything. The runtime crops one column, three cells tall.
The model reads that strip as an image, with nothing else in its prompt.
It answers a digit, a carry, and the next operation.
Plain code paints the answer and moves the window. Nothing else passes between steps.

scenes.title: One step, forever
scenes.say: Every step has the same shape.

parts.note: the runtime shows a view from a finite list
parts.say: The runtime shows a view, from a finite list.

parts.note: the model: a function of the view alone
parts.say: The answer depends on that view alone.

parts.note: same answer, same next sheet: induct on steps
parts.say: So matching the table on every view means matching every run, step by step.

scenes.label: views cover addition, multiplication, subtraction and division
scenes.say: Two thousand four hundred and forty six views cover every procedure. Addition needs two hundred and forty two.

scenes.title: Every view, checked on the laptop

steps.say: All pass on the laptop GPU. The weakest, five plus six, still leads by three logits.
If steps read their own history, a decoder can pass every test, then fail on a longer run.

scenes.title: Where the guarantee lives
scenes.say: What did Lean prove? Three links, one proof.

items.say: Right on every view: measured, on one device.
Views imply every length: the Lean theorem.
Runtime shows only table views: assumed, and asserted.

left.title: Chain of thought
items: Each step reads all earlier steps
left.say: Chain of thought grows its context. No finite test certifies it.

right.title: Pinned sheet
items: A finite check covers every length
right.say: The pinned sheet has a fixed list of inputs. Check them all.

scenes.text: Bound what each step can see, and exactness at every length becomes a finite list you can check.
scenes.mark: a finite list you can check

recap: Three cells in, one step out
scenes.say: Check every view, and induction does the rest.
